body:
Worker-02 continuation of #1201. These are isolated review proposals against the campaign's unchanged maintained owner bytes, not applied data changes. All artifact paths are repository relative. The published predecessor at `58f885fef05f8ff6e8b9b56fcb2479fef23b55c8` remains unchanged.

Four current pure-substance owners accept concentration-qualified or hydration-erasing strings as resolving aliases. The proposed corrections preserve each exact token and original source as `REJECTED_LABEL`; they do not invent stock recipes or change the established solute identities.

| Owner | Tokens made non-resolving | Bounded reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Fe_Nh42_So42_X_6_H2o.yaml` | `Fe(NH4)2(SO4)2 x 6 H2O (0.01% w/v)`, `Fe(NH4)2(SO4)2 x 6 H2O (0.1% w/v)`, `Fe(NH4)2(SO4)2 x 6 H2O (2% v/v)` | Concentration-qualified preparation labels do not unconditionally identify neat Mohr hexahydrate. |
| `Na-pyruvate.yaml` | `1 M Sodium pyruvate*` | The explicit 1 M preparation is not the neat sodium-pyruvate substance. |
| `Voso4_X_5_H2o.yaml` | `VOSO4 x 5 H2O (0.01% w/v)`, `VOSO4` | One is preparation-qualified; the other omits the five waters required by the exact hydrate. |
| `Methanol.yaml` | `Methanol (10%)` | The original stock-strength versus receiving-medium-dose interpretation is unestablished. Either interpretation is unsuitable as an unrestricted molecular-identity alias. |

ChEBI 76181, 50144 and 132758 establish the compared solute scopes. They are not evidence for an unstated solvent or a complete formulation. The vanadyl source's CAS12439-96-2 and owner's CAS14708-82-8 differ as annotations; the inspected ChEBI132758 response lists both, so their difference alone is not a chemical contradiction. Preserve both facts rather than silently replacing either.

ATCC2883 separately specifies filter-sterilized methanol, 3 mL added after autoclaving. The exact methanol proposal records that source-qualified treatment in notes and supplied_form on the existing molecular owner. It does not create a new mixture from filtration alone or infer assay, dilution, solvent or filter pore size.

Independent reviewer `/root/final_reviewer` approved the exact composed Mohr payload and its seven scoped cases in `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-02/continuation-1201-v1/d/independent-review-mohr-v2.json` (SHA256 `9b22001a7400cf1c979dc26ba526ade6155245d79502e564b46ed35bf98cbdab`). This is not a whole-owner, merge or publication approval.
Independent reviewer `/root/research_a` approved the exact pyruvate and vanadyl payloads within the declared C-review scope in `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-02/continuation-1201-v1/a/review-c/independent-review.json` (SHA256 `37577be2e1881e5e32fb430f68ffd15a7dedc86994b135c9bd5764f3b3116a71`). This is not a whole-owner, merge or publication approval.
Independent reviewer `/root/research_b` approved the exact methanol payload within the declared A-review scope in `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-02/continuation-1201-v1/b/independent-review-a-binder-v1.json` (SHA256 `f4521c3947dc1a79cde4b5ac94bae8770470cd4c2b83faeab6171b1c931a4206`). This is not a whole-owner, merge or publication approval.

The Mohr receipt binds the final composed successor, including all six preserved earlier source aliases and the three new rejections. Approval of C's isolated fragment alone was not treated as approval of that composition. Bare-formula, generic-hydrate, role-like and other full-owner obligations remain held.

Vanadyl requires cross-shard reconciliation: the captured coordinator observation records worker10 `chem-proposal-113` at head `dbaf4629f3b93d3bd8a78028e243abfe90c7a922`, payload `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-10/chemicals/proposed/Voso4_X_5_H2o.yaml`, SHA256 `7b38dec9fd6f28a46639ef4dd0f14d7c2bcd4db6c5bfca1f33f9dfe76fcbeef4`, against the same baseline owner. It proposes a source formula-ordering alias from TOGO M2262. That is a distinct delta from worker02's two rejections. Preserve both proposal histories and require independent review of the exact combined bytes before integration; this observation does not attest worker10's scientific review, choose a winner or approve worker10's source cases. Observation: `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-02/continuation-1201-v1/validation/cross-shard-overlaps-v1.json` (SHA256 `5ff9da544c2b1bfa043712df04eedc85fda2d4942adb0a7b749f9692d9a280b3`).

Existing #1189 covers glyoxylate, vanadate, AQDS and carbonate, not these four owners. #1203 concerns magnesium-sulfate stock occurrences. #702 mentions Na-pyruvate for a historical CAS-to-ChEBI import defect, and #752 mentions methanol within hydrogen-gas aliases; neither covers these exact tokens. This is a bounded related bundle, not a closure of those issues or #718's release umbrella. Keep the recorded Mohr, sodium-pyruvate and vanadyl WITHHOLD reasons and all other source/owner/release obligations until separately assessed.

Before applying any accepted delta, compare the then-current owner bytes and reconcile concurrent proposals. Preserve every raw label, original source reference, existing REJECTED_LABEL, WITHHOLD, source-quantity and downstream hold. Use guarded curation with history and the required maintained-surface/SSSOM synchronization and native validation. This draft requests no merge, downstream rebuild, automatic owner release or closure of broader issues.
